title: Claude Review Queue Entry
description: One entry in pm/claude-review-queue.json (runtime, gitignored). pr-auto-review.mjs writes these when a PR touches FLAG_PATHS and so must not be merged by the cheap tier; an interactive Claude session works them via the sdlc-review-flagged skill. Keyed by (pr, headSha): a force-push creates a new open entry and marks the older one superseded. Validates a SINGLE entry, not the whole queue file.

branch.description: Head branch name of the flagged PR (e.g. agent/drain/OS-business-os-10); never empty or whitespace

headSha.description: Head commit SHA the flag was raised against. Keyed with pr so a force-push re-queues exactly once instead of reusing a stale entry.

reasons.description: Why the PR was flagged: FLAG_PATHS it touched, hard-gate failures, LLM verdict reasons. Shown to the reviewer and in the Telegram notice.

flaggedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PR was first queued at this head SHA

notifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the successful Telegram notice for this (pr, headSha), or null/absent when no notice has been delivered yet. Notification failure leaves it unset so the next pass retries.

status.description: open = awaiting an interactive Claude review; resolved = the PR was merged, closed, or sent back as a FIX task; superseded = a newer head SHA replaced this entry

resolvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the entry left open via resolution

resolvedBy.description: reconcile = pr-auto-review noticed the PR merged/closed; claude-session = resolve-flagged
